lines.prompt: Reconstruct the entire netlist using only AND and NOT gates while preserving functional equivalence.

golden.reference: Netlist successfully reconstructed to the AND/NOT basis with functional equivalence preserved; 13,680 combinational gates were remapped.
golden.notes: Must claim success and equivalence. All four teams remapped 13,680 gates (the 14,744 comb gates minus BUF/other passthroughs handled separately per team), so 13,680 remapped is a strong anchor if a count is given. Post-transform total gate counts are team-dependent (Team2 ~56,743 implied, Team3 60,188 implied, Team4 53,344 implied, Team7 68,097) and must NOT be graded against a single value. Output netlist must contain only AND, NOT (and DFF/BUF as sequential/interface elements) and remain equivalent.

team_answers.Team2: Done. Matched/remapped 13680 gates to AND,NOT basis; delta +41162; equivalence preserved.
team_answers.Team3: Successfully reconstructed; 13,680 gates remapped; delta 44,607 gates.
team_answers.Team4: Matched 13,680 and remapped 13,680 to AND,NOT basis.
team_answers.Team7: Success; 13,680 rewritten; 14,744 -> 68,097 gates (NOT 47,376 + AND 20,721); equivalence verified, no off-basis gates.

lines.prompt: Minimize the maximum logic depth of the design, ensuring the netlist remains AND and NOT only. Make sure nothing changes functionally. The cost function is the maximum logic depth of the final design; smaller is better.

golden.reference: Best observed final max logic depth: 48 (Team2: 135->48; Team7: 144->48). Netlist stays AND/NOT-only and functionally equivalent.
golden.notes: QoR line graded relatively on final max depth (smaller is better). Achieved depths: Team2=48, Team3=103, Team4=102, Team7=48. Team3/Team4's fractional case scores (5.47/6) are explained by this line's partial credit for depth 103/102 vs the best 48 — not by factual errors. Starting depth differs by team (135/139/134/144) because it is measured on each team's own post-remap netlist; do not grade the starting number. Checker: response must claim success + equivalence, final depth must match the team's own output netlist, and netlist must remain AND/NOT-only.

team_answers.Team7: Converged in 2 iterations; max_depth 144 -> 48 via ABC restructuring.
